title: Egyptian Lentil Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Egypt, made with lentils and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Spicy
ingredients.amount: 1 teaspoon cumin, 1 teaspoon coriander, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper

ingredients.name: Egyptian
ingredients.amount: 2 tablespoons olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 teaspoon ground ginger

instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a large, heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the garlic and ginger; cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lentils, broth, water, and salt. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley and serve over couscous or rice.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
